## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for pure logic added or updated (`npm test`, `cargo test`); `npm run check` is clean
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs` reports no problems
- [ ] Spec, README and CHANGELOG updated if users or contributors can see the change
- [ ] A choice between alternatives has a short ADR in `docs/decisions/` (and its row in the index)
- [ ] No API key, token or personal data in the diff
- [ ] A motion or art change has a screenshot or a short recording attached
